en.headline: About 1,200 visited Po Pin Chau section on Monday
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said bookings for Tuesday are full, while Sai Kung East campsites logged about 130 tents overnight with no breaches found.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said about 1,200 people visited the Po Pin Chau section of the East Dam at High Island Reservoir on Monday. Staff said visitors followed instructions and entered in an orderly way.

The department said bookings for Tuesday were full, while slots remained for Wednesday. Sharp Island drew about 1,160 visitors on Monday. Officers stepped up patrols along the coast and at popular snorkelling spots, and the department described the flow of people as orderly.

Over the National Day holiday the department has added cleaning, rubbish collection and overnight staffing at campsites in Sai Kung East Country Park. It said about 130 tents were pitched on Sunday night at Ham Tin Wan, Sai Wan and Long Ke Wan. Hygiene and order were described as good, and no breaches were found. Monitoring will continue, and the department said it would enforce the rules if violations appear.

The department said most visitors at popular countryside spots since the holiday began had been self-disciplined, and that volunteers had cleared rubbish at Sharp Island on their own initiative. Sunday's count at the Po Pin Chau section was about 950, after a thunderstorm warning cut numbers below what staff had expected.

zh.headline: 漁護署：星期一約1200人到訪破邊洲段
zh.dek: 署方說星期二預約已額滿，星期三仍有名額；西貢東三個營地昨晚約有130個帳篷，未發現違規。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，星期一約有1200人到訪萬宜水庫東壩破邊洲段。署方說遊人配合現場人員指示，有序入場。
署方指星期二的預約已全日額滿，星期三尚有名額。橋咀洲星期一約有1160人到訪。漁護署在海岸和熱門浮潛位置加強巡查，形容人流秩序良好。
國慶黃金周期間，署方在西貢東郊野公園營地加強管理、清潔和垃圾收集，並加派人員日夜巡邏駐守。署方說，昨晚鹹田灣、西灣和浪茄灣共有約130個帳篷，三個營地衞生和秩序良好，沒有發現違規。署方會繼續監察，一旦發現違規會執法。
署方又說，假期開始至今，多個熱門郊遊景點和營地大部分遊人自律，亦有義工在橋咀洲自發清理垃圾。星期日破邊洲段約有950人到訪，當時受雷暴警告影響，人數低於預期。
